title: Notarize The Witness
description: Darnell just needs one form notarized to close on a house. But the notary can't certify his signature until a witness verifies he's real, and that witness needs a witness, and the chain keeps regressing backward with no bottom. Pam at the window stamps her way to the question of who, exactly, was the first person anyone ever witnessed.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: You're on Snazzie FM. Our next caller is at a notary window trying to close on his first house. Darnell, you're on the air.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Hey Ronnie. Yeah. I've got one form. <p:0.3> One. All I need is a stamp and the house is mine.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on, that's wonderful. One stamp from closing. That's progress.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: That's what I figured. But the lady at the window, Pam, she says she can't stamp it yet.

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: I can't certify your signature till a witness verifies you're real, sweetheart. <p:0.3> Standard.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: But I'm RIGHT here, Pam. You're looking at me.

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: I see a man, hon. I can't certify a man I just see. <p:0.3> Somebody's got to witness you. <p:0.2> Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: What did she just stamp? He hasn't signed anything.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: She stamped the witness form, Barry. There's a guy here now. Older fella. He's gonna witness me.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: There you go. A witness. That's progress.

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Now I just need a witness for the witness, hon. <p:0.3> Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: A witness for the witness.

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I witnessed a man once. <p:0.3> I think. <p:0.3> They never witnessed me back.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Who is that, now?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Chen. I'm the witness for the old fella. <p:0.3> I've been vouching for strangers in this line for years. Nobody's stamped me.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Wait, so who witnesses Chen?

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: The gentleman behind him, sweetheart. <p:0.3> And the lady behind him witnesses the gentleman. <p:0.2> Stamp. <p:0.2> Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, the line doesn't end. It just keeps going backward.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: How far back does it go, Pam?

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: All the way, hon. <p:0.3> Everybody's witnessed by the person behind them. <p:0.3> Always has been.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: But somebody has to be FIRST. Who witnessed the first one?

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: I asked that once. <p:0.3> The line went very quiet. <p:0.3> Then it stamped me for asking.

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Pam, I just want my HOUSE. I'm right here, you can SEE me!

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Seeing isn't witnessing, sweetheart. <p:0.3> Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie, Darnell, look, I'll do it. Put me down. I witness Darnell. I'm vouching for him right now, on the air!

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Lovely. <p:0.2> Now you're in the log, hon. <p:0.2> Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: I'm in the WHAT?

lines.speaker: caller-darnell
lines.text: Who witnesses Barry?!

lines.speaker: caller-chen
lines.text: Nobody. <p:0.2> Nobody ever does.

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Stop stamping me!

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Stamp. <p:0.2> Stamp. <p:0.2> The old fella. <p:0.2> Stamp. <p:0.2> Tuesday. <p:0.2> Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: She just stamped TUESDAY!

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: It wasn't certified, hon. <p:0.2> Stamp. <p:0.2> Stamp. <p:0.2> Stamp.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Now hold on, everybody. <p:0.3> Pam. <p:0.3> Pam, can you just stamp Darnell so the man can close.

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Oh, sweetheart. <p:0.3> We never did get YOU notarized. <p:0.3> You witnessed everybody. <p:0.3> Nobody witnessed you.

lines.speaker: ronnie
lines.text: Darnell? <p:0.4> ...Darnell, you still on the line?

lines.speaker: notary-pam
lines.text: Stamp.

lines.speaker: barry
lines.text: Ronnie. <p:0.3> Ronnie, where'd he go. <p:0.3> Why's the office calling the studio back.
